description: Compile error footers say (defk <code>: docs/language.md#<code>). In a dependency or a Hex install that path doesn't exist. Make the footer point at the HexDocs page for the installed version (e.g. https://hexdocs.pm/defk/<version>/compile-errors.html#<code>) or a local path when running from the repo, and make the catalogue its own guide page with stable anchors generated from errors.ex. Update the tests that check footers and the catalogue/docs sync. Coordinate with the guides split.

comments.text: Decisions: (1) Footer is the catalogue's path when docs/compile-errors.md is on disk next to lib/ (repo, path or git dep; relative to cwd, e.g. deps/defk/docs/compile-errors.md#code), else a URL. URL = GitHub blob on main for now (works today; defk not on Hex so hexdocs would 404; main not a tag/commit because no tags exist yet and codes are never renamed so anchors stay valid). Base is one attribute, @url_base in lib/defk/errors.ex; switch to https://hexdocs.pm/defk/<version>/compile-errors.html# at Hex release. (2) Catalogue moved to docs/compile-errors.md (extra in @reference), generated by Defk.Errors.reference/0, checked verbatim by test/compile_errors_doc_test.exs. Headings are the codes, plain [a-z0-9-] slugs, identical anchors on GitHub and ex_doc (tested). language.md section 11 is a pointer; all links to codes moved.

title: Compile error links that work outside the repo
